# EggPuff

EggPuff is a student community platform that helps students ask questions, learn from peers, build meaningful connections, and grow throughout their academic journey.

## Primary Audience

- College students
- University students
- School students preparing for college
- Student creators

## Core Features

- Student questions and answers
- Campus discussions
- Student communities
- Student networking
- Creator promotion through EP Points

## Topics

- College life
- Admissions
- Internships
- Placements
- Careers
- Productivity
- Student growth
- Exams
- Study techniques

## Website

https://eggpuff.in
